🎬 Rocky (1976)

Rocky follows Rocky Balboa, a small-time boxer from Philadelphia who earns a living collecting debts while dreaming of becoming a successful fighter. His life changes when heavyweight champion Apollo Creed unexpectedly gives him the opportunity to compete for the world title. Despite being considered an unlikely contender, Rocky dedicates himself to intense training with the help of his experienced trainer Mickey Goldmill. Along the way, he develops a heartfelt relationship with Adrian, a shy woman who inspires him to believe in himself. As the biggest fight of his life approaches, Rocky realizes that proving his worth means more than simply winning a championship. Starring Sylvester Stallone, Rocky delivers an inspiring story about determination, love, courage, and refusing to give up on your dreams.

🎭 Genre: Sports • Drama • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 59m • PG

🎥 Director: John G. Avildsen

✍️ Writer: Sylvester Stallone

🏆 Awards: Winner of three Academy Awards, including Best Picture.
